book.name: Aposel
book.title: APOSEL Aposel wagle kongun erikwa kamo

content: “Nenma angrima wagle, na mambunona erme ene meglmara diteimbo piryo.”
Ana Pol eremogl Aram kanno mina dungo pirtre ye ka kaima ta dikre kiendi meglko ana Pol yegl dungwa,

“Na Juda yagl ta moglka, Silisia siti, Tarsus kamun igle na kugl yeingwa, ba na Jerusalem suna igle mogl yakinga. Te Gamaliel skulmo mina digo ana ye nono neno kowano lono i giglendi beke narko pirka, te ene erme God kongunmo ounedi eremeglmere yegl na ama okuna yegl erika.
Ana Yaglkande Konbaunamo kor i mina duglo beglkwa yomba na eresi tendre sigoragledi erika, te yagl ya ambu akiye sikanesi ana ipi kane yungu endinga.

Pris kande ya Kaunsol wagle ye ombugl na ka dinga i ka kaima dume dinaglkwa. Ana angro Juda yomba Damaskas meglkwa ipre ye pepa bogl nariko na indre ana yomba i sikanesi yend ikine Jerusalem wimbo ana kane panaglmedi pre na ende imbo Damaskas einga.
Pol nomano yake tomere ka boglo kuglkwa
“Na endpi Damaskas magl eingo 12 klok orko ana tambre kaima heven imbo ambuglange pesungwa ta ende atne undre na were isuna endungwa.
Na yange makandle singo ana ka ta yegl dinarko pirka, ‘Sol, Sol! Ene sraglpre na eresi tenatne?’
“Na krapoglka, ‘Ene irane Yaglkande?’ “Ana ye di ikine endungwa, ‘Na Yesus Nasaret kamun nem, ene erekinde erenatnga!’
Yomba na bogl akiye omga ye ambuglange i kanigwa ba yomba ta ka dinarkwa i ye pirkrikwa.

“Ana na krapoglka, ‘Yaglkande, na sragl eragle?’ “Ana Yaglkande yegl dinarkwa, ‘Ene andigl ende Damaskas kamun suna emin, igle ene taragl ta prapra eratnedi pre God dipanduglkwa i yomba ta ene ditenambuka.’
Ana ambuglange kande sungwa i na ongumutna akemim orkwa, yeglpre yomba na bogl omga i na onguna ake ana auro ipi Damaskas kamun suna eingwa.

“Ana igle yagl ta moglkwa kangiye Ananaias, ye na kanapre ungwa. Ye God dembiye karaugl kaima eretendre no lono pamere i pinande orko ana Juda yomba Damaskas kamun meglkwa i kindaginde ye pre yagl wakai kaima we dingwa.
Ananaias undre na moglmara koglokra andigl mogl yegl dungwa, ‘Angra Sol, ene ongumutn aglkekor kanatnga!’ Yegl dungo tambre kaima na ongumutna pinedungo ana ye kaninga.
“Ana Ananaias ka yegl dinarkwa, ‘Nono kowano Godno nomane mina taragl ta eragledi prukwa, i ene pirpogl sindre te Yagl Du-yene i kandre te ka dra mina dinambuka i kamo piratnga pre ene pinde yungwa.
Ipre ene taragl pirtre te kandre etnga i ana yomba kindaginde diwaidi tenatnga.
Ana erme ene sraglpre enge kanana sugl motne? Ene andigl baptais indre ye kangiye datn ana ene tandaglmen koko endinambuka.’
Pol kamambuno Yomba Bina meglmara dinambuka pre God diendungwa
“Ana okuwo na ende ikine Jerusalem undre God holi yungumo mina kamange ere moglko ana ongumutna-mugl ta orko,
ana Yaglkande ka dungo na kaninga. Ye yegl dinarkwa, ‘Tambre kana Jerusalem kindekondo endpo. Sraglpre, ene na pre kanna dimin yomba ta pir ikraglkwa.’
“Dungo na yegl di ikine ende teinga, ‘Yaglkande, yomba yene pirkan erikwa, okuna na makai yungu yei omere omere yungugl pi yomba ene wedi pirngi dingwa ye kane sindre te uglmbo kumba si-si erika.
Te ene kan boglo kugl yomba te-te orkwa yagle Stiven sigeglko na ama igle andigl mogltre, na pra sigoraglmedi pirtre ana eresingwa yomba gatno suna na sugl moglkra.’
“Ba Yaglkande yegl dinarkwa, ‘Endpo. Sraglpre, na ene diendimbo ende eglkekuri Yomba Bina meglmara enatnga.’”
Pol Rom yomba mole dungwa
Yomba kinano yei pir mogl eingo ana Pol ka i dungwa. Ba yomba kaglkane indre dingwa, “Sigolo, yomba yeglmere makandle moglkrambuka. Te ye kor-morambuka kuno erekrukwa.”
Ye kaglkane ertre gatno suna olto gugl ake piya kayasi makan kungane wombro piyasi mitna endingwa.

Yegl eriko kimbirnem sutno kande moglkwa dungo ana kimbirmonem Pol auro yend kimbirnem toglno suna eingwa. Ana Pol pre yomba kaglkane pond ingwa i mambuno sraglpre erikwa i ye piragledi pre kimbirnem kumba sindre krapeglmbi ana mambunomo kaima diporambe dungwa.

Ana ye Pol kane kogl kumba sinamnedi eriko, Pol yegl di kimbirnem ende okuna eingwa yagle igle andigl moglkwa i tongwa, “Rom yomba ta ene ka-tange tekre te aglaumo kanpogl sikre ana kumba tambre kana sinaglkwa i lomo pamo?”
Yegl dungo kimbirnem ende okuna eingwa yagle ka i pirtre ye pi kimbirnem sutno kande moglmara pi ditendre krapoglkwa, “Ene sragl eragledi pitne? Yagl i Rom yomba kaima moglkwa.”
Ana kimbirnem sutno kande Pol moglmara pi krapogl tongwa, “Ene dinaro, kaima ene Rom yomba motno?” Ana Pol dungwa, “Na kaima moglka iwe.”
Dungo, kimbirnem sutno kande yegl dungwa, “Na Rom yomba moragledi pre moni merkinde ipi topo ertre ana Rom yagl kaima moglka.” Ba Pol di ikine endungwa, “Na mana kugl yomere Rom yagl moglka.”

Yegl dungo ana yomba krapogl Pol tenamnedi erikwa ikra kundugl gogltre ana tambre kana kinde kondingwa. Te kimbirnem sutno kande moglkwa ye prukwa Pol kaima Rom yomba moglkwa pango ana ye sen mina kane keglkwa ipre ama kundugl prukwa.

Kamun tangungo ana kimbirnem sutno kande eremogl Juda yomba ka di Pol kitne erikwa i mambuno kaima piragledi pre Pol kane keglkwa i poko endungwa. Yegl ertre pris kande wagle ya te kaunsol wagle wu makai sinaglmedi pre ka-singiye diendungwa. Te okuwo Pol auro ipi ye meglmara endungo gumanomugl andigl moglkwa.

footnotes.text: Aposel 16:37 kanamga. Rom yomba lono ta yegl dungwa: Mane giglendi ta pangwa i Rom yomba igle ta kumba wip sindre ere sikraglkwa.
